task.title: Verificar el update y aplicar rollback stop conditions
task.shortdesc: Inicie el BPM process actualizado, verifique probes, UI, API evidence y documentation status, y decida si accept, stop o restore from backup.

prereq.p: Migrations, source smoke y documentation rebuild checks se completaron o se registró un failure point.

context.p: Post-update verification prueba que el source run actualizado es usable para la controlled environment actual. No prueba production readiness, reverse proxy behavior, HA, managed backup ni Firefox runtime enforcement.

step.cmd: Inicie el source process actualizado y compruebe probes.

info.codeblock: make dev curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/ready

step.cmd: Verifique product UI, API evidence y documentation status.

info.p: Abra http://127.0.0.1:8000/profiles, ejecute los required reusable API examples, confirme exported policies.json evidence cuando corresponda y revise que /help/ no informe stale, incompatible o missing documentation para el installed artifact.

step.cmd: Acepte el update solo cuando cada required check esté registrado.

info.p: Registre previous revision, target revision, migration result, source smoke result, documentation validation/build result, health/readiness responses, UI smoke result, API/export evidence y cualquier known deferred production controls.

step.cmd: Aplique rollback o stop conditions sin inventar automatic recovery.

info.p: Si failure ocurre antes de migrations, vuelva a la previous source revision y reinstale dependencies. Si failure ocurre después de migrations, detenga BPM, restaure el verified pre-update database backup, vuelva a la previous source revision, reinstale dependencies y repita health/UI smoke checks. Si falta backup evidence, restore no está verificado o data cambió después de migration, deténgase y escale en vez de reclamar rollback success.
info.note: No marque el update como complete cuando probes fail, documentation stale, exports difieren inesperadamente, migrations son uncertain o rollback evidence está incomplete.

result.p: El update queda accepted with complete evidence, stopped at a known blocker o restored from the pre-update backup with explicit proof.

postreq.p: Use la resulting evidence en la operations handoff note y en future production/HA/reverse-proxy planning.
